description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

External tracking: ../workspace-planning epic work-pim. Tasks work-pim.1–.5 own SDK/adapter implementation, review, coverage and fetchable immutable revisions; work-pim.6 owns the exact mix.exs/mix.lock update here. This is a local verification gate because the trackers are separate; a textual external ID is not a native dependency edge.
Do not close based on elapsed time or a similarly named old API. Require recorded completion/validation evidence for the Mattermost fixes, exact published/fetchable SDK/Mattermost revisions and the intended pin/lock applied in this worktree. Inspect resolved source and public entry points: requirements, pure exact candidate multipart sizing, one-request upload, one-post create/edit, no hidden batching/policy/fan-out.
No new adapter work or duplicate dependency update here. Work-pim.6 remains owner of pin changes.
Avoid a dependency cycle: if work-pim.6 has applied the correct revisions but only old ZAQ policy/fan-out integration checks await THIS migration, record those precise failures and transfer their compatibility verification to the Jido/journeys tasks. Provider checks and fetchability must already pass. Do not require closure of the entire external epic before fixing that documented host-only incompatibility. Leave work-pim.6 open until host verification succeeds.
Files: inspect mix.exs, mix.lock and resolved dependency public contracts; no code changes in this gate.
Tests: reuse external recorded quality/contract evidence and existing ZAQ adapter compatibility fixtures; distinguish actual provider failure from expected old-host mismatch.
Branches: incorrect revision, missing public callback, unresolved limits, unavailable ref and real SDK post/edit compatibility.
Action reuse: verification only; no new Action. Documentation: record immutable revisions, external statuses, tests and any transferred host-only blockers.
Only this gate should initially be ready. No implementation child may start before it closes.

comments.text: External work-pim.1-.4 local implementation/review complete; work-pim.5 coverage/publication handoff underway. Corrected dependency code has NO fetchable immutable revisions yet; no commits/pushes authorized, and work-pim.6 has not edited this worktree pins. Gate remains open. Provider API: file_requirements, pure prepare_upload, upload_prepared, uploaded_files native opt-in, single create/edit. Host migration must remove adapter policy forwarding/requirement and forward independent max_upload_request_size. Exact static blockers recorded in work-pim.6; transfer host-only verification to zaq-1lw.6/.9 once published provider revisions are applied, avoiding an epic closure cycle.

title: [zaq-1lw.1] Gate: verify completed Mattermost prerequisites and adopted revisions
